# TestPilot - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: TestPilot
- Tagline: Regression-test your LLM app before every ship.
- Domain: https://testpilot-ai.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- Paste a prompt and expected behavior; get an eval checklist and version regression guard. For dev and QA teams shipping LLM-powered product features.
- Regression suites
- Safety checks
- CI integration
- Version compare

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — 50 eval runs/mo
- **Pro** — $49/mo — 5k runs, regression suites
- **Team** — $99/mo — Unlimited, CI, seats
- Checkout: https://testpilot-ai.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://testpilot-ai.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. What is TestPilot?
A1. Paste a prompt and expected behavior; get an eval checklist and version regression guard. For dev and QA teams shipping LLM-powered product features.
Q2. Do I need an API key?
A2. No. The platform key runs the engine; Enterprise offers BYOK.
Q3. How is my data used?
A3. Only to produce your eval report. We do not train public models on it without consent.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON download and clipboard on every plan.
